reason: $59 a month is a lot on my budget, and I'd have to pay gas on top every visit. I'd wait and see reviews before spending anything on it.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so a monthly membership is hard to justify. I also can't tell how clean it will be until I read reviews or see it, and it isn't even open yet.
would_change_my_mind: Open for a while with lots of good reviews that mention cleanliness, plus a cheap or free trial visit before I commit to a membership.
